name: Cheesy Spinach Omelette
steps: Crack 3 eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt, and whisk for 30 seconds.
Heat a teaspoon of oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add a handful of spinach and cook for 1 minute until it wilts.
Pour the eggs over the spinach and let them set for 1 minute without stirring.
Sprinkle cheese over one half, then fold the omelette in half with the spatula.
Cook 1 more minute, then slide onto a plate and serve.

name: Spicy Tofu & Broccoli Rice Bowl
steps: Rinse 1 cup of rice, add it to a pot with 2 cups of water, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low for 12 minutes.
While the rice cooks, press the tofu, cut it into cubes, and pat dry.
Heat a little oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the broccoli florets and 2 tablespoons of water, cover, and steam for 3 minutes.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of chili sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Spoon the rice into a bowl, top with the tofu and broccoli, and add shredded lettuce on the side.

name: High-Protein TVP & Potato Scramble
steps: Dice 1 potato into small cubes and microwave for 3 minutes, or boil until just tender.
Soak 1/2 cup of TVP in 1/2 cup of hot water for 5 minutes, then squeeze out the extra water.
Heat a little oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the potato cubes for 4 minutes until browned.
Add the TVP, 1 teaspoon of cumin, and a pinch of salt, and cook for 3 minutes, stirring often.
Add a handful of spinach and 1 tablespoon of chili sauce, and cook until the spinach wilts, about 1 minute.
Taste, adjust the seasoning, and serve hot.
